# ARCH-4: A feature not every vehicle needs costs nothing to the users who do not use it

It has its own enable define, defaulted in the library's `_config.h` and listed in `build_options.py`, is off where flash is tight, and compiles out completely, with guards around whole functions and `case`s rather than inside them. The PR states its flash cost on a small board.

Confirmed 2026-10-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
